safe.bio: Abu Dhabi-born, Toronto-rooted singer, rapper and songwriter SAFE makes atmospheric contemporary R&B that blends tender balladry with trap, dancehall and Afrobeats influences.

said the whale.bio: Vancouver indie-rock band Said the Whale pairs hook-heavy guitar pop with atmospheric folk, bittersweet storytelling and a long-running independent Canadian career.

sarah harmer.bio: Burlington, Ontario singer-songwriter Sarah Harmer is a Canadian folk, pop and rock artist whose warm vocals and environmentally engaged songwriting have anchored a career spanning band and solo work.

saukrates.bio: Ottawa-born, Toronto-based rapper, singer, songwriter and producer Saukrates is a foundational Canadian hip-hop artist whose career spans solo work, production and the R&B group Big Black Lincoln.

savannah ré.bio: Toronto singer-songwriter Savannah Ré makes intimate contemporary R&B built around vulnerable storytelling, slow-grooving production and a powerful, expressive vocal style.

saya gray.bio: Toronto-born multi-instrumentalist Saya Gray makes adventurous alternative pop and R&B that folds psychedelic textures, electronic production, folk elements and intricate bass playing into an idiosyncratic solo sound.

scott helman.bio: Toronto singer-songwriter Scott Helman makes melodic Canadian pop built around conversational writing, guitar-led songwriting and polished contemporary production.

serena ryder.bio: Ontario singer-songwriter Serena Ryder is a Juno-winning Canadian artist whose powerful vocals move across folk, rock, pop and roots music with emotionally direct songwriting.

shad.bio: Kenya-born, London, Ontario-raised rapper and broadcaster Shad is one of Canada's most acclaimed alternative hip-hop lyricists, known for thoughtful writing, multiple Polaris nominations and hosting Hip-Hop Evolution.

ruth b.bio: Edmonton-born singer-songwriter Ruth B. makes piano-led alternative pop and R&B, rising from short-form social media performances into a globally streamed Canadian songwriting career.
